notes.title: Update # 3 Controller Support,Bug fixes and Minor Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Controller support and customizable controls  has been added to the game.You can change the controls in the Options menu in the Controls submenu.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/a65fea82c8b20d1b3bd220b9e99f7b6cf819ce0d.png[/img]
[*] From now on you can also navigate through the menus by using your mouse.
[*]The Time Trial game mod has been removed since it didn't work as it was intended. In the next update I'm planning to add it back with an added Ghost Replay function.
[*]Small icons of the racers has been added to the minimap.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/1ad914283250efa5d865e900b85d6d6e5cf66c52.png[/img]
[*]All other changes are mainly revolving around the menus and the overhauls of it due to the requirements needed to be navigable with the mouse
[/list]

notes.title: Update # 2 Major Game Overhaul ,Bug fixes and Minor Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*]The big major change is mainly on the game's graphical side because I partially gave up on having the graphics on the exact same level as  the original NES Super Mario Kart release had back then and I toke a small steps above the graphical limitations of SMK's graphics with some simple 3d objects,walls,fences,buildings  and other things that could give more life to the levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/714b25e3761927d8c20b641f2cdb0016a4f97fb9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/a0e460897b63033e5491be91176893ca28487a9f.png[/img]
Here you can see the Before and After pictures about the changes that the levels  went under.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/292bf4e2f316b20c0105d085ab7050ea98a013b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/c8781bcf86fba4a2e914d1bfc27b3276f6598c9d.png[/img]
[*]A completely new level has been added :The Airfield mainly inspired by the airfield scene at the end of the PIMP MY WHEELCHAIR.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/0c9b648425e93a0838a97f14d899fe932cb68ee0.png[/img]
[*]Another thing is from now you can see your items behind your character being draged  and you can also see the other racer's items from behind of them so now you know what you can expect from your rivals if you want to overtake them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/9a111df8939bc15d4ae09dc21bdaa0fd4f00e72e.png[/img]
[*]Other changes are mainly just menu related things.which are not really noteworthy
[/list]
I will try to put out another update in this month with at least 5 new levels.I also already started to work on the controller support and local split screen co-op so the controller support should be out in early February if not sooner.

notes.title: Update # 1 Options Menu,Pause Menu,Bug fixes and Minor Content Update
notes.content:
[*]Options Menu(Thought it was necessary to make one ASAP because the game sounds are obnoxiously loud by default.I also added a fullscreen option.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/6c51aa4147eb7fab4a83df403622035c49fc1fee.png[/img]
[*]Pause Menu(Instead of the ugly debug tool that I left in the game as a way to be able pause.Now there is a real pause menu.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/f363e5a71f7d1897d0f50d0e5cfb229dda24cd02.png[/img]
[*]Fixed the bug regarding the Custome Race menu.
[*] Added some landscape objects (traffic cone,road closed sign Click on the image to see a short video about the it)
[url=https://thumbs.gfycat.com/PaleMisguidedCuttlefish-mobile.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/163a043b5c5b2584e4080067efe74427a909819f.png[/img][/url]
[*] Added a water splash animation for when the player or any other racer fell into the water(Click on the image to see the animation)
[url=https://thumbs.gfycat.com/AmusingPlainIberianlynx-mobile.mp4][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801923/4a831eb20e65fb62b9eac4bf250651e48cd782f1.png[/img][/url]
[*]Now the mini map will disappear after the race since previously it completely bugged out and also there is no real reason to be there at all after the race is finished. 
[/list]

That's all  for this update.
